related_resources.reason: Scholarly context for Hindustani raga as more than a scale or fixed tune.
Introductory Indian educational descriptions of raga practices.
Sixteen-matra tintal organization and performance context.
Maqam, ajnas, sayr, and distinctive melodic behavior in Arabic art music.
Institutional overview of Arabic maqam structures.
Role of oral pedagogy, intonation and ornaments in the acquisition of raga.

description: Examines a careful comparison of selected Hindustani and Arabic art-music concepts, without pretending that they stand for every Indian, Middle Eastern, or non-European tradition. The companion distinguishes factual descriptions from an explicitly invented exercise.
